```{r}

library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(rgeos)
library(data.table)

```


Code for extracting track data

```{r}


fn <- function(l) {
  as.data.frame(l)
}

#read in background course

background_course <- read_json(**Add filepath for background_course.json**)

#read in track file

track1_dat <- read_json(**Add filepath for Unit_124_R_24C3n0g2sO3kdS2_brainstorming_track.json**)

background_course_bind <- bind_rows(lapply(background_course$lines, fn))

track1_bind <- bind_rows(lapply(track1_dat$lines, fn))

#Subtract background course from track file

track1 <- anti_join(track1_bind, background_course_bind)

#plot the track

ggplot(track1) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = x1, y = -y1, xend = x2, yend = -y2)) +
  coord_equal()

track1


#Get all the y coordinates for the track for the x-coordinates that span from 0 to 2000 (boundaries of course). the .json files save line data as line segments with endpoints x1y1 and x2y2. The following code calculates the value of y for x values that fall in between these end points by calculating where y would fall on the straight line between the two points

track1_process <- lapply(seq(0, 2000, by = 1), function(g) {

apply(track1, 1, function(h){  #for each row in the dataset...
           
         if(g >= as.numeric(as.character(h[3])) && g <= as.numeric(as.character(h[5]))) {  #do the following for g values that fall between x1 and x2 in that row
           
           data.frame(x = g, start = h[4], end = as.numeric(as.character(h[6])), y = -1 * (as.numeric(as.character(h[4])) - (   ( (as.numeric(as.character(h[3])) - g) * (as.numeric(as.character(h[4])) - as.numeric(as.character(h[6]))  )) /  (as.numeric(as.character(h[3]))  -  as.numeric(as.character(h[5]))  ))))
           
         }  
  

         }) %>% bind_rows()  
  
})  %>% bind_rows() 


track1_process

#Calculate the median y value for every x value (thick or irregular lines may have some values of x that have more than one y value close to one another)

track1_med <- group_by(track1_process, x) %>%
    summarize(y = median(y)) 

track1_med

#Plot the updated track

ggplot(track1_med) +
  geom_line(aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  coord_equal() 


```

```{r}


all_tracks <- rbind(mutate(track1_med, Response_ID = "R_24C3n0g2sO3kdS2"), mutate(track2_med, Response_ID = "R_3HHdu3VVXMNkn2i"), mutate(track3_med, Response_ID = "R_1GP6IKXl0PYyt4s"), mutate(team_track_med, Response_ID = "TeamTrack"))

ggplot(all_tracks) +
  geom_line(aes(x = x, y = y, color = Response_ID)) +
  coord_equal()
```

```{r}


brainstorming_tracks <- rbind(mutate(track1_med, Response_ID = "R_24C3n0g2sO3kdS2"), mutate(track2_med, Response_ID = "R_3HHdu3VVXMNkn2i"), mutate(track3_med, Response_ID = "R_1GP6IKXl0PYyt4s"))

line0 <- sp::SpatialLines(list(sp::Lines(sp::Line(cbind(team_track_med$x, team_track_med$y)), ID = 'a')))
 



norm_dists <- lapply(unique(brainstorming_tracks$Response_ID), function(n) {
   
b <- filter(brainstorming_tracks, Response_ID == n)
   
line01 <- sp::SpatialLines(list(sp::Lines(sp::Line(cbind(b$x, b$y)), ID = 'a')))
   
line_pts <- methods::as(line0, "SpatialPoints")
comparison_pts <- methods::as(line01, "SpatialPoints")

line_coords <- sp::coordinates(line_pts)
comparison_coords <- sp::coordinates(comparison_pts)

start <- line_coords[1, ]
end <- line_coords[base::nrow(line_coords), ]

coords <- base::rbind(line_coords, comparison_coords[nrow(comparison_coords):1,])

p = sp::Polygon(coords)
ps = sp::Polygons(list(p), 1)
sps = sp::SpatialPolygons(list(ps))

line_pts <- methods::as(line0, "SpatialPoints")
comparison_pts <- methods::as(line01, "SpatialPoints")

line_coords <- sp::coordinates(line_pts)
comparison_coords <- sp::coordinates(comparison_pts)

start <- line_coords[1, ]
end <- line_coords[base::nrow(line_coords), ]

coords <- base::rbind(line_coords, comparison_coords[nrow(comparison_coords):1,])

p = sp::Polygon(coords)
ps = sp::Polygons(list(p), 1)
sps = sp::SpatialPolygons(list(ps))

plot(line0)
plot(line01, add = T, col = "red")
plot(sps, col  ="black") 

rgeos::gArea(sps)

spp2 = gPolygonize(gNode(gBoundary(sps)))

data.frame(Response_ID = n, norm_dist = gArea(spp2) /  1526304) #1526304 is the maximum possible area between tracks in our course

}) %>% bind_rows()

norm_dists

```
